items.name: b12077
items.body:
<details open>

meta: support GLM-5.3 next sm tensor (#30499)

* meta: support GLM-5.3 next sm tensor

* glm5-next : cont q_absorbed for -sm tensor with non-unified KV

* meta : keep GGML_OP_ARANGE in ggml.h order

* glm5-next : split MLA heads in pairs for -sm tensor

The MLA cache has a single KV head, so the heads on a device are its GQA
ratio. The HIP tile FA kernel for D=512 needs an even GQA ratio; with 3
devices the 16 heads of the test model were split 5/5/6 and it aborted.

* meta : keep the split for views inside one slab of the split axis

With a non-unified KV cache, build_attn_mha splits q into streams with a
view. For a permuted q, e.g. the absorbed query of glm5-next, that view
aborted with "view of permuted tensor not implemented". The split is now
kept if every other dim of the source and the view stays inside one slab
of the split axis. The per-device strides are only rescaled above it.

From tetherto/qvac-fabric-llm.cpp#353.

Co-authored-by: Pratik Narola <pratik.narola@tether.io>

* glm5-next : drop the q_absorbed cont

The meta backend can now split the per-stream view of the permuted q, so
the cont is not needed for -sm tensor with a non-unified KV cache. With
the cont, the q of flash attention was not contiguous, and when FA ran on
the CPU (WebGPU) the meta get_tensor aborted.

---------

Co-authored-by: Pratik Narola <pratik.narola@tether.io>

</details>

<details open>

metal : fix cpy kernel for dst non-contiguous in dim 0 (#31581)

kernel_cpy_t_t indexed the dst innermost dim with an implicit element-size
stride instead of args.nb0, so cpy into a permuted view (nb0 != type size)
wrote the wrong addresses. caught by the new test-backend-ops cpy case with
permute_dst = {1, 0, 2, 3} from #31446. addressing is unchanged when dst is
contiguous in dim 0.

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

delta_net_base: refactor conv state (#30878)

* delta_net: access conv state via views

* fix sm tensor

* delta_net: fill the conv slot index on the host

The rollback slot index of the conv windows is a constant per graph
shape. It is now an I32 input of the recurrent memory filled on the
host, instead of an arange and an argsort computed on the device, and
the meta backend no longer needs a mirrored split for ARANGE.

---------

Co-authored-by: Pascal <admin@serveurperso.com>

</details>
